name: Drop Shelf
author: Carlos Granier
description: A drop zone in the bar: drag files onto it from anywhere, as many times as you like, then drag the shelf into a folder or pick one, and everything is copied or moved there.

barWidget.description: Stages file locations dropped on it. Drag the shelf into a folder, or press the target to choose one, to copy or move them all at once. Nothing is touched until you deliver.

schema.label: Keep files on the shelf after copying
schema.description: Off: a successful copy clears the copied items from the shelf. On: they stay, so you can deliver the same set to another folder. Moves always clear.
